title: Checksum-Verified Pages
description: Stores a checksum with every index page and verifies it on each read, catching disk corruption and torn writes immediately. A page that fails verification is never trusted - it is quarantined and routed to repair instead of serving wrong results.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Automatic Page Repair from Replica
description: When a page fails its checksum, the system fetches the same page from a healthy replica and overwrites the corrupt copy. The repair happens inline during the read, so the query succeeds with correct data and the corruption is gone before the next read.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Online Index Rebuild
description: Rebuilds a damaged index in the background while the database keeps serving queries from the old copy. When the new index is complete and verified, traffic flips over atomically - no downtime, no maintenance window, no angry users.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: B-Tree Rebalancing
description: Detects B-tree nodes that have grown lopsided from uneven inserts and rebalances them during idle time. Balanced trees keep lookups at logarithmic depth, so rebalancing directly defends query latency against data skew.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Orphan Page Reclamation
description: Finds index pages that are no longer reachable from any root - orphans left by crashed operations - and returns them to the free pool. Without reclamation, orphans silently eat storage until the disk fills for no reason.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Write-Ahead Index Log
description: Logs every index mutation before applying it, so a crash mid-update can be replayed or rolled back to a consistent state. The index is never left half-written: recovery brings it to the last fully logged operation.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Background Scrubber
description: Continuously reads index pages during idle time and verifies their checksums, finding corruption before any query touches the bad page. Scrubbing turns silent data rot into a routine maintenance event instead of a surprise outage.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Divergent Replica Convergence
description: Compares index replicas with Merkle trees and repairs only the divergent branches, instead of copying whole indices. Convergence is efficient and provably complete: when the root hashes match, the replicas are identical.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Partial Index Rebuild
description: Rebuilds only the damaged key range of an index instead of the whole structure, using the base table rows for that range. Partial rebuilds finish in seconds where full rebuilds take hours, and the healthy ranges never stop serving.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Index Statistics Refresh
description: Recomputes the statistics the query planner uses - row counts, value distributions, selectivity - when they drift from reality. Fresh statistics keep the planner choosing good query plans; stale ones are a classic cause of sudden slow queries.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Fragmentation Compaction
description: Repacks fragmented index pages during low-traffic windows, merging half-empty pages so scans read fewer blocks. Compaction reclaims space and speeds up range scans, and it runs online with readers never blocked.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Crash-Safe Index Commits
description: Makes index updates atomic with a two-phase commit: prepare the new pages, then flip a single root pointer. Readers always see either the old or the new index, never a mixture, even if power fails mid-commit.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Redundant Index Roots
description: Keeps multiple copies of the index root metadata in separate locations, so losing one to corruption never loses the index. Root copies are checksummed and voted on at startup; a lone bad copy is discarded and regenerated.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Anomaly-Triggered Rebuild
description: Watches query latency and result anomalies for the signature of index corruption - sudden slowdowns or impossible results - and triggers a rebuild automatically. The system heals from symptoms even when checksums somehow miss the underlying damage.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Repair Audit Trail
description: Logs every healing action - what was corrupt, what repaired it, when - into an append-only audit trail. The trail proves the index's integrity history to auditors and helps engineers spot disks or replicas that corrupt repeatedly and need replacing.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
